name: ultimate-frontend-skills
description: Ultimate Frontend Skills (UFS for Claude). Build cinematic, editorial websites, app screens and game start screens the way an award-winning studio does, on one route from brief to ship: a corpus of award-winning reference sites to decide against, WebGL mesh gradients, three-plane parallax with real depth, procedural and Blender-modelled three.js exploded product views, CC0 PBR materials and HDRI lighting, scroll choreography in GSAP and anime.js, and a typographic system that does not read as AI-generated. Ships a copy-in CSS chassis, motion and WebGL runtimes, a section library, a scaffolder, a headless render check, a bench detector that defers to frontend-design when it is installed, and one verify verdict.
